articles.title: Tokenized Google stock inflated 7,700% in rare DeFi lending exploit
articles.snippet: An attacker inflated the value of a tokenized Google share used as collateral to about 78 times its real price, then borrowed against it, leaving roughly $403,000 in bad debt.

articles.title: Trump earned more from crypto than real estate in 2025, filings show
articles.snippet: Memecoin sales and royalties made the most money for Trump last year, more than all of his golf courses combined.

articles.title: Bitcoin just $5K away from ‘best investment opportunity’ of bear market
articles.snippet: Bitcoin's recent selloff brought it within 10% of its realized price — a line that has marked the bottoming zone in Bitcoin's previous bear markets.

articles.title: AI’s power crunch turns Bitcoin miners’ grid access into an asset
articles.snippet: Bitcoin miners have the power sites AI companies need, but turning old mining campuses into real data center revenue is no easy pivot.
